cpmplus.w6animx.menu.situations: Movement that stops when the situation changes…
cpmplus.w6animx.menu.situations.desc: Shows parts that move while walking/standing but stop when jumping, falling or sneaking.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.title: Movement that stops when the situation changes
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.intro: In game only one situation plays at a time (standing, walking, jumping...). A part the current situation doesn't animate stops and goes back to its normal position.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.sentence: '%s' moves in %s, but not in %s: it stops and goes back to its normal position %s.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.note.custom: During a custom pose or gesture the situations don't play; use Global or an on/off button.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.note.server: Jumping and Falling depend on the server: other players may not see those situations.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.preview: The movement of '%s' goes to a Global animation, which always plays. It will also play in: %s, during gestures and custom poses.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.conflicts: These animations still move that part (with the same priority, a replacing Global wins over the situation):
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.notEqual: The tracks of this part are not the same in every situation; use 'Copy to the missing situations'.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.globalBusy: The Global animation already moves that part; merge by hand or use 'Copy to the missing situations'.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.move.done: The movement of '%s' is now in '%s'
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.from: Copy the movement of '%s' from '%s' to:
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.adjust: Fit the key times to each animation's length
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.copy.jump: Animations with a different length may jump when switching.
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.warn: %s part(s) stop moving in some situations. Example: %s
cpmplus.w6animx.sit.when.falling: when falling more than about 4 blocks
cpmplus.w6animx.part.head: Head
